primary_contracts.name: ZKVerifierSP1
primary_contracts.description: SP1 Groth16/PLONK proof verification with nullifier tracking, circuit registry, batch verification, composed calls, cross-chain relay, and dTAO stake-gated verification
key_concerns: Proof verification bypass via malformed inputs

primary_contracts.name: CoreRevenueSplitter
primary_contracts.description: Fee collection and distribution (30/30/25/15 split) with multi-chain Fee-to-Stake routing to Theta/Bittensor/Cosmos validator pools, x402 escrow, and deferred claims
key_concerns: Reentrancy in distribute() with multiple external calls
x402 escrow claim and refund edge cases

primary_contracts.name: veXFGovernance
primary_contracts.description: Curve-style vote-escrowed governance with linear decay, ZK nullifiers, per-type quorums, and on-chain execution hooks to CoreRevenueSplitter
key_concerns: Voting power manipulation via flash loans
Double voting via ZK nullifier bypass

primary_contracts.description: Library for SP1 proof integration, nullifier computation, fee commitment hashing, and cross-chain payload encoding

primary_contracts.name: ThetaInferenceCircuit
primary_contracts.description: Theta EdgeCloud AI inference circuit with 7 service types, preset hooks, GPU tier pricing, and Core Layer fee integration

security_properties.access_control: OpenZeppelin AccessControl with role hierarchy (DEFAULT_ADMIN → FEE_MANAGER → CIRCUIT → GOVERNANCE)
security_properties.replay_protection: Nullifier-based (keccak256(proofHash, chainId, nonce)) on both EVM and CosmWasm
security_properties.circuit_breaker: Auto-pause at >5% failure rate in ZKVerifierSP1
security_properties.zk_integrity: SP1 Groth16 verification via ISP1Verifier gateway

scope: ZKVerifierSP1.sol — proof verification bypass, nullifier replay
veXFGovernance.sol — voting power manipulation, governance takeover
SP1ProofHooks.sol — nullifier collision, payload encoding mismatch
ThetaInferenceCircuit.sol — service catalog manipulation, fee forwarding, state machine bypass
CosmWasm contracts — proof bypass, state corruption
exclusions: Theoretical attacks requiring >51% of veXF supply

properties: Nullifier uniqueness: no two valid proofs produce the same nullifier
Circuit breaker monotonicity: failure count never decreases
Batch verification completeness: all items processed or none
Split conservation: sum of all transfers equals input balance
Voting power monotonicity: VP never increases without lock action
Lock integrity: totalLocked = sum of all active lock amounts
Proposal finality: executed proposals cannot be re-executed
